text:
Priya: Tiny noon experiment: 'One-liner and a snack' challenge. Bring a line, win the cookie jar coin. :cookie:
Liam: I'm entering: 'My plants vote me as roommate.' :seedling: :raised_hands:
Zoe: "Coffee machine finally apologized." That's my entry. :coffee:
Ben: I wrote "Fridge Tupperware is just collaborative art." :framed_picture:
Priya: ops-bot heads-up: interview in room B at 12:15, keep it low?
ops-bot: Reminder: Quiet rooms reserved 12:10	612:40. Please keep celebratory kazoo use to a minimum.
Liam: Acknowledged. Kazoo ban noted. :no_entry_sign:
Zoe: Also, is anyone claiming the leftover bagel with the tiny smear of cream cheese and a mysterious seed? :bagel:
Ben: Not me. It has a cryptic Post-it: "If found, cherish it."
Priya: That's definitely Mark's handwriting. He steals bagels as performance art.
Liam: Poll: react :thumbsup: to join the one-liner circle. Winner picks the cookie coin.
Zoe: :thumbsup:
Ben: :thumbsup:
Priya: Cool, 3 entrants. Prize: one golden coin (in the jar) and eternal bragging rights. Also loser does a dramatic reading of the lunchroom rules.
Liam: Loser territory is a good incentive. I practiced my slow-lecture voice.
Zoe: Reminder: if you label food, include a fake ominous backstory. People respect lore.
Ben: Fun fact: cilantro is actually just cilantro, but we pretend it's a personality.
Priya: OK see you at noon. One-liners must be delivered in under 3 seconds. Speed matters. :stopwatch:
Zoe: May the snappiest line win. :sparkles:
